svg.text: Collatz total stopping time s(n) for 2¹⁴ ≤ n < 2²⁰, as a contour map
x: the 64 classes n mod 64, sorted by a = odd steps among the first 6 steps of
n → n/2 or (3n+1)/2. y: log₂ n. Contours every 5 of mean s; terraces = values of a.
Fit over all n in [2¹⁴, 2²⁰): s ≈ 12.30 a + 7.23 log₂ n − 39.2; the heuristic
1 + 7.23·log₂ 3 predicts an a-slope of 12.46. Terrace means rise 96.3 → 170.3.
Mean s by n mod 16 spans 107.2 (r = 0) to 156.6 (r = 15), ×1.46.
n mod 64 explains 7.0% of the variance of s; control n mod 81: 0.01%, n mod 1000: 3.6%.
